name: Adzviser Business Profile
description:
Connect your Google Business Profile (fka Google My Business) data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about views, phone calls, and bookings. Compare locations, dig into how customers find and contact each listing, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking last week's activity or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser Business Profile to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser Business Profile to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://business-profile.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser Business Profile MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Business Profile provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_google_my_business, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser Business Profile?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser Business Profile in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser Business Profile MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Business Profile requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser Business Profile is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
